rows.Bloom: Pink - russet, lighter reverse. Flowers pink-bronze, reverse lighter. Mild fragrance. 25 to 30 petals. Average diameter 2.25". Double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose or cut flower.
rows.Breeder's notes: Unusual color, brownish pink. A rose for cutting.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
